step1_figure.description: An actively driven, bootstrapped all-NMOS clock driver/buffer that uses capacitive bootstrapping on internal nodes A and B to pull the output pull-up transistor gate above VDD, achieving full rail-to-rail swing without static current consumption and avoiding latch-up.

output_high_voltage.description: Maximum steady-state output high logic level

equation.explanation: Because boot node B is boosted above VDD + VTHN, the pull-up NMOS xm13 operates in the triode/linear region when pulling up, pulling the output completely to VDD without a threshold drop.
equation.assumptions: Bootstrapping capacitor xmc2 is sufficiently large relative to parasitic capacitance, and input clock is actively toggling.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD = 1.8 V and node B booted above VDD + VTHN (V_B > 1.8 + 0.42 = 2.22 V), xm13 pulls the output to VDD = 1.8 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In linear region with VGS > VTHN, NMOS xm13 pulls Out to full supply rail.

output_low_voltage.description: Minimum steady-state output low logic level

equation.explanation: Actively driven 40/1 pull-down NMOS xm11 pulls the output node directly to ground when S is low and R is high.
equation.assumptions: Pull-up device xm13 is fully shut off.

sky130_expected.calculation: With xm11 actively conducting to 0 V and xm13 off, V_OL = 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Pull-down transistor actively ties output to GND with zero DC load.

equation.explanation: Full rail-to-rail voltage excursion achieved by avoiding threshold voltage losses via bootstrapping.
equation.assumptions: Cload is standard capacitive load (100 fF) without DC resistive loading.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The bootstrapped driver provides rail-to-rail operation from 0 V to 1.8 V.

boot_node_b_peak_voltage.description: Peak voltage at bootstrapped node B driving the output pull-up NMOS gate

equation.explanation: Node B is precharged and then capacitively boosted when S goes high to allow Mpu to pull out to VDD.
equation.assumptions: Capacitor xmc2 (10/10) provides adequate coupling ratio C_boot / (C_boot + C_par).

sky130_expected.calculation: Precharged to ~VDD - VTHN = 1.8 - 0.42 = 1.38 V (or via active driving to near VDD), then boosted by capacitive coupling of clock transition (delta V ~ 1.2 - 1.5 V), reaching ~2.4 - 2.8 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Must exceed VDD + VTHN (1.8 + 0.42 = 2.22 V) to prevent threshold drop across xm13.

rise_time.description: Output 10% to 90% rise time driving Cload = 100 fF

equation.explanation: Time required for the 40/1 pull-up NMOS xm13 to charge the 100 fF load capacitance from 0.18 V to 1.62 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: With (W/L) = 40/1, un*Cox = 270 uA/V^2, beta = 10.8 mA/V^2. Average charging current ~ 2 - 4 mA. t_rise ~ 100 fF * 1.44 V / 3 mA ~ 48 ps + internal node boot delay ~ 0.2 - 0.8 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large 40/1 output device rapidly charges 100 fF once boot node B rises.

fall_time.description: Output 90% to 10% fall time driving Cload = 100 fF

equation.explanation: Time required for the 40/1 pull-down NMOS xm11 to discharge the 100 fF load capacitance from 1.62 V to 0.18 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: With xm11 gate driven to ~1.38 V (VDD - VTHN), VGS - VTHN ~ 0.96 V. I_D ~ 0.5 * 10.8 mA/V^2 * (0.96)^2 ~ 5 mA. t_fall ~ 100 fF * 1.44 V / 5 mA ~ 30 ps + inverter delay ~ 0.2 - 0.8 ns.

propagation_delay_low_to_high.description: Propagation delay from input S rising (50%) to Out rising (50%)

equation.explanation: Delay through internal bootstrapping stages to pull output to 50% VDD.
equation.assumptions: Input clock edges have 100 ps rise/fall times.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of pre-driver stage delay and output charging delay: ~ 0.3 - 1.0 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Multiple cascaded NMOS stages to couple and bootstrap internal nodes.

propagation_delay_high_to_low.description: Propagation delay from input R rising (50%) to Out falling (50%)

equation.explanation: Delay through reset stage and pull-down driver to discharge output to 50% VDD.
equation.assumptions: Input clock edges have 100 ps rise/fall times.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay from R turning on xm15 to charge gate of xm11 and pull down output: ~ 0.2 - 0.8 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct gate drive to xm11 pull-down yields fast high-to-low transition.

average_power.description: Average dynamic power consumption at 100 MHz clock frequency

equation.formula: P_avg = (1/T) * integral(VDD * I(VDD) dt) approx f * Cload * VDD^2 + P_internal
equation.explanation: Total power consumed from 1.8 V supply during operation; circuit avoids continuous static current by active switching.
equation.assumptions: f = 100 MHz, VDD = 1.8 V, Cload = 100 fF.

sky130_expected.calculation: P_load = 100 MHz * 100 fF * (1.8 V)^2 = 32.4 uW. Including internal node capacitance (~300 fF total equivalent), P_avg ~ 100 - 300 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Static current is eliminated; only dynamic capacitive charging and shoot-through during switching consume power.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for Figure 18.40b NMOS clock driver measuring output logic levels, peak boot voltage, rise/fall times, propagation delays, and average power at 100 MHz clock frequency with 100 fF load.
